title: patentsview 1.0.0
text: API key required: new API requires authentication. Request key https://patentsview-support.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portals set PATENTSVIEW_API_KEY environment variable. Endpoint changes: Now 27 endpoints (7). Endpoints singular (e.g., patent patents). nber_subcategory endpoint removed; cpc_subsection now cpc_group. Field changes: patent_number now patent_id. Raw inventor name fields (rawinventor_first_name, rawinventor_last_name) removed. fields now nested require full qualification queries (e.g., cpc_current.cpc_group_id). Paging parameters changed: per_page/page replaced size/. Maximum size 1,000 (10,000). Result sets now unbounded (capped 100,000). httr httr2 migration: passed config = httr::timeout(40), now use timeout = 40 directly. cast_pv_data() removed: API now returns proper types (boolean, numeric, etc.) instead strings.
